title: APIv2 PCR Prep 2/4: GAP
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter all required protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface before generating the script.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the Python protocol file that was generated from the entered parameters.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck according to the map:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: 96‑well PCR plate on the PCR Cooler (already filled with samples from the previous step).
Slot 2: Labcon 0.2 mL PCR strip (catalog #3940‑550) on the PCR Cooler, positioned in column 1 and pre‑filled with master mix.
Slots 4‑11: 10 µL/20 µL Opentrons tipracks for the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, perform calibration of all labware, tipracks, and the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

substeps.instruction: Run the labware calibration routine for each piece of labware on the deck.
Run the tiprack calibration routine for the 10/20 µL tipracks.
Run the pipette calibration routine for the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the Opentrons App to start the PCR prep – GAP (part 2/4) protocol for 96 samples.
